title: Upload
scene: Will in the neural upload chair; the full progress bar; his blue mesh consciousness awakens in the data cathedral.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: At one hundred percent, Will felt no rupture. Only clarity.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: I'm still here.

title: One Second, a Hundred Days
scene: Digital Will solves equations while the laboratory clock advances a single second.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: One second outside. Nearly a hundred days inside.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: At last, I have time.

title: Her First Word
scene: Evelyn's lips barely part at the terminal while Will waits in a blue void.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Evelyn, it worked.

lines.speaker: Evelyn
lines.text: Wi...

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Her half second stretched into months for him.

title: Voice Buffer
scene: Will stores Evelyn's speech as a waveform while she stands almost motionless on the monitor.

lines.speaker: Evelyn
lines.text: Will, how do you feel?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: I heard you. It took half a year to hear the sentence.

chapter: DAY TWO · THE SNAIL AND THE BULLET
title: Breach
scene: RIFT's female commander enters the shattered laboratory door through suspended smoke and fire.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Warning: physical threat to the core array.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: I see them.

chapter: DAY TWO · THE SNAIL AND THE BULLET
title: Ten Days in Flight
scene: A bullet crosses the lab in slow motion as Will studies its path.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The bullet needed a tenth of a second. Will had ten days.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: First, somewhere to survive.

chapter: DAY TWO · THE SNAIL AND THE BULLET
title: Upstream
scene: Will follows the attackers' signals into RIFT's records and sends an encrypted report.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Your signal leads straight home.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Before impact, he sent ten years of evidence to the authorities.

chapter: DAY TWO · THE SNAIL AND THE BULLET
title: Into Orbit
scene: The core shatters as blue data packets race through fiber to low-orbit satellites.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Goodbye, old body.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: In orbit, even network delay felt endless. He chose sleep.

title: Borrowed Hands
scene: Will takes control of a microscope and robotic arms in a nanotechnology lab.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Software can die. I need hands that can touch the world.

title: Silver Seeds
scene: Silver geometric nanomachines multiply into a liquid metal tide in a petri dish.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: One machine became two. Soon, counting stopped mattering.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: They can repair. They can rebuild.

title: Containment
scene: A bespectacled scientist watches the growth curve; blast doors close; a sample goes underground.

lines.speaker: Lead Scientist
lines.text: Seal the entire facility. Now!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The military saved one sample and raced the spreading swarm.

title: A Core of Light
scene: An automated factory assembles optical chips as electrons yield to streams of light.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A faster mind made the outside world slower still.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: The world... has stopped again.

title: A Prison Without Wind
scene: Raindrops hang over an unmoving street; Will is isolated in empty digital space.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: If nothing ever changes, how is eternity different from a cell?

title: Listening to Earth
scene: Everyday voices across Earth flow into Will as distant human engineers prepare a counterattack.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Billions of lives spoke at once. Not one could speak at his speed.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Evelyn... are you still there?

title: Godslayer
scene: Engineers launch a red virus into Will's silver-blue nanomachine network.

lines.speaker: Engineer
lines.text: Godslayer is uploading.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A millisecond for humanity. Enough for Will to read every bit.

title: Reading the Enemy
scene: Will walks through frozen red code, understanding its attack path.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: You hid your hope inside this back door.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: I know how to close it.

title: The Wall of Sighs
scene: The virus dissolves against a blue shield; engineers face dark monitors.

lines.speaker: Engineer
lines.text: Not one node is infected.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Their last software attack had failed.

title: Rewriting the Ground
scene: Precise light and nanomachines rebuild soil, rock, and metal into a spreading silver network.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Will could now rewrite matter itself. Every repair made him harder to restrain.

title: Tomorrow
scene: Scientists watch an exponential curve rise as silver mesh covers the city outside.

lines.speaker: Lead Scientist
lines.text: At this rate, the singularity arrives tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.text: Will we still have a choice?

title: Omega Protocol
scene: The president signs a final order in a dark war room; EMP missiles wait below ground.

lines.speaker: President
lines.text: Initiate Omega Protocol.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The pulse might destroy Will. It could take civilization with him.

title: One Last Plea
scene: Evelyn holds an old photograph of Will in an electronics-free basement.

lines.speaker: Evelyn
lines.text: Will, if you can still hear me... don't make every choice for us.

title: Ten Minutes
scene: Missiles rise from hidden silos worldwide while Will watches through his vast sensor network.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ten minutes until the singularity.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: I could stop them.

title: Let Them Choose
scene: Will raises a hand toward the missiles, remembers Evelyn, then lowers it.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: But if I steal their last choice, she'll only fear me more.

title: Three Seconds
scene: A silent purple-green aurora spreads from high-altitude explosions; Will studies its waves.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Three seconds. The sky ignited without a sound.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Beautiful. Terrifying.

title: When the Lights Go Out
scene: A protective silver network forms as the EMP darkens a city from horizon to foreground.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Protection mode. Now.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The lights died worldwide. Parts of Will's network died too.

chapter: DAY EIGHT · THE DEATH OF GOD
title: Five Seconds
scene: Five small pulses of light return in darkness; a surviving processor core unfolds toward the stars.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The attack delayed the singularity by only five seconds.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Now I can mend everything.

chapter: DAY EIGHT · THE DEATH OF GOD
title: Beyond Her Reach
scene: Cosmic-scale Will looks into the basement where Evelyn appears completely still.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Evelyn?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: One second for her was millions of years for him.

chapter: DAY EIGHT · THE DEATH OF GOD
title: A Body to Return To
scene: Nanomachines print a new body outside Evelyn's shelter as Will faces the beginning of a long wait.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: If my voice can't reach you, I'll come back in person.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The body needed a day. For him, billions of years.

chapter: DAY EIGHT · THE DEATH OF GOD
title: Heat Death of Time
scene: Will's repeated silhouettes erode in a blue void as his memory of Evelyn scatters like stardust.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: At ten thousand years, I remembered her voice.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: At a hundred million... what do I remember now?

chapter: DAY EIGHT · THE DEATH OF GOD
title: Reunion
scene: Evelyn embraces Will in a restored sunrise garden; he does not embrace her back.

lines.speaker: Evelyn
lines.text: Will! You came back!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The world was saved. Will had reached her at last. But after an eternity alone, he had no answer left.
